paragraphs.text: They are cautious with their body language and facial expressions. Any stray movement could betray the positions of the troops they protect and cost many lives.
Ixidor had only to imagine their ruin and Akroma made it so.
"Better the dead depart utterly than be enslaved."
"Truth shines even in darkness. Those who march on the side of truth walk always in righteous light."
"In the gathering there is strength for all who founder, renewal for all who languish, love for all who sing." —*Song of All*, canto 642
"Purge the damned, for they have no place among the righteous!" —Seeta of Thraben
Infinitely powerless.
Its wings disturb more than air.
Unaware of Lorwyn's diversity, it sees only itself, reflected a thousand times over.
"My family protects all families."
Some timelines forever fray, branch, and intermingle. Others end abruptly.
"Until the world unites in vengeful fury and Phage is destroyed, I will not stay my hand." —Akroma, angelic avenger
Perfect justice in service of a perfect will.
She preaches the blessings of the Machine Orthodoxy.
"Body and spirit are sworn enemies. They will take any excuse to be rid of each other." —Tariel, Reckoner of Souls

"I prefer loyalty to be a matter of respect, not of magic. But one does what one must." —Kaalia of the Vast

"As long as I pull the strings, you will dance." —Tezzeret
Sentience is its natural habitat.
The winds of change have a mind of their own.

"Don't worry, your death will be as informative as possible." —Gorghul, augur of skulls

"We must all make sacrifices for the good of Innistrad." —Sorin Markov
The travelers were warned to watch out for children on the road.

The wise always keep an ear open to the whispers of power.
Those who hear its roar perish. The lucky ones only feel its fetid breath.
"Did you have a nice nap?" —Liliana Vess

"Why do you weep for the dead? I rejoice, for they have died for me."

"From a tiny sprout, the greatest trees grow and flourish. May the seeds of your mind be equally fruitful."

It claws at the earth in a vain attempt to reclaim what it once was.
His roots reach deep and grip hard.

"Eyeblights are easy to track. Just follow the imperfections."

In a culture of beauty, the most beautiful are worshipped as gods.

"Give up these unnatural weapons, these scrolls. Heart and mind and fist are enough." —Zyd, Kamahlite druid

One bone broken for every twig snapped underfoot. —Llanowar penalty for trespassing
From the highest tiers of Dawn's Light Palace to the deepest shade of Wren's Run, the silver notes of the horn shimmer through the air, and all who hear it feel its pull.
"Beauty determines value, and we determine beauty."
The land knows no difference between the graves of commoners and nobles.
Nature doesn't walk.
"My skills are wasted here." —Juruk, Kalonian tracker

"Here lies Gond, hero of Safehold Taldwen. May he ever guide our quest."

"When the land is angry, so are they." —Nissa Revane
"What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

"Hold the line, hold the li—" —General Srok, last words

Few who encounter the strange, human-like grove leave once the lilting chorus of the dryads reaches their ears.
It's there when a seed sprouts, when gourds ripen on the vines, and when the reapers cut the grains under the Harvest Moon.
"Not all paths are found on the forest floor."
"He has been to the heart of the wood. Did you truly expect to wield power over him?" —Oakhide druid

If you hear it, it's too late.
Even through the Mirari's voice, the elves still hear the call of their kinship.

"You may enter, but leave those lifeless things of your world behind." —Modruni, maro-sorcerer

Each flower identical, every leaf and petal disturbingly exact.
"Close your ears to the voice of greed, and you can turn a gift for one into a gift for many."
Urza tried to rule the air, but Gaea taught him that she controlled all the elements.
"Knowledge is a stain that only instinct and ferocity can cleanse." —Drarg, wolfcaller

To the Golgari, anything buried is treasure.
"I'll have my revenge if I have to call on every force from above and below."

A demon cannot be trusted, and a dragon will not be ruled.

"Time and space are just new battlefields to be mastered."
"Take up the quill, and feel your future flow into the runes."

Rakdos festivals almost leave enough rubble in their wake to hide the bodies.

The mysterious purpose of two of the rings had eluded Esper mages—until now.
"The higher the mind soars, the greater its understanding of the law." —Isperia

"It reflects the purity of Mirrodin-that-was." —Koth of the Hammer
"Gods don't die. They merely slumber." —Ayli, Kamsa cleric

Mages come from far and wide to bathe in its wisdom.

The mind is a beautiful bounty encased in an annoying bone container.
Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

Infinite possibilities contained in a finite space.
Paradoxically, to tilt the massive jug for a sip, you'd need the energy of the giant's tonic.

Enter the Senate, the seat of justice and the foundation of Ravnican society.

When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

Deserted, but not uninhabited.
Enter those who are starving and sick. You are welcome among the Swarm when the rest of Ravnica rejects you.

A ghoulcaller's playground.
If it can't be had here, it can't be had on any world.
For wisdom's sake, it was built high to gaze on all things. For glory's sake, it was built high as a testament of power. For strength's sake, it was built high to repel all attacks.
Enter and rejoice! The Conclave stands united, open to one and all.
Enter and comprehend the perfection of orchestrated life.
Those who bring nothing to the temple take nothing away.
Nothing lives within it, yet there is life.
